text:
lea: Quick thread 2-week push for the Mini-Notebook Refapp. Goal: publish 3 tutorial posts, one benchmark story, and a live office-hours webinar. Need owners for: blog copy, benchmark ops, webinar, and inbound routing.

omar: I can write the blog series + code snippets. Want each post to be ~600 words, code-first with a short TL;DR.

jess: I'll run the benchmark harness and produce a one-paragraph hero stat plus a table. Plan: compare default vs. batching+cache on 512-token demos.

lea: Good. Keep hero stat simple: "median latency down X ms, cost down Y%". No vendor-blingo.

tony: I'll own webinar ops and the office-hours format. Propose 45 minutes: 20m demo, 15m Q+A, 10m breakout help rooms.

zara: Inbound routing: I suggest 3 LP CTAs mapping to lists: OSS stars -> maintainers stream, trial users -> product demo, community -> tutorial drip. Also want UTM tags for all links.

omar: Blog structure idea: post 1 = quickstart + run locally; post 2 = optimize with batching & cache; post 3 = deploy patterns (hosted vs private). Each post links to the refapp repo.

jess: For the benchmark table Ill include columns: model, seq, median(ms), p99(ms), cost/token($). Will attach raw CSV and small script to reproduce.

lea: CTA language test: (A) "Try the Mini-Notebook refapp" vs (B) "Run the tutorial in 5 minutes". Pick one for hero A/B.

zara: A/B is fine. Also add a partners micro-flow: maintainers get an invite to a private slack and early-review checklist.

omar: Need a small code snippet for the blog hero. Proposed snippet: ```bash
ri start-refapp --example notebook
```

jess: Bench infra ask: 150 GPU minutes for runs on representative models. Approve?

lea: Approved up to 150. Log under GH issue mini-notebook-bench.

tony: Webinar speakers: two engineers + one community maintainer. Want to record sections as short clips for socials.

zara: Email plan: announce -> deep-dive post -> webinar invite -> replay. Use dynamic content: show different hero CTA based on segment.

omar: I'll make small GIFs of the notebook flow for the LP hero.

jess: I'll output a simple badge: "Bench: 2.1x cost improvement" for LP variant B. Keep numbers reproducible.

lea: Messaging notes: emphasize developer time saved and reproducible cost improvements. Avoid absolute claims like "cheapest".

tony: Ops note: set registration cap to 300, allow waitlist, enable live captions.

zara: Routing detail: add Zapier webhook to push registrants to CRM and tag by segment. Also add trigger: if user has >2 repo contributions, send maintainer invite.

jess: Uploading benchmark CSV + script to repo in /benchmarks/mini-notebook. Will link in post.

omar: Drafting post 1 now. ETA EOD tomorrow. Need editorial review and small code formatting pass.

lea: Great. Owners recap: Omar = blogs & refapp assets, Jess = benchmark + reproducibles, Tony = webinars & recordings, Zara = inbound routing & email flows. Launch-bot please create GH issue and remind us in 24h.

launch-bot: Created issue #1427 "mini-notebook-refapp-launch-playbook" and set reminder for 24h.

omar: One blocker: need approval for social budget to promote the first post. Can marketing ops approve $600?

lea: Approved $600 for initial promo. Track link UTM.

zara: I'll draft email copy variants and share in #marketing-drafts. Will include preheader variations.

jess: Will attach a short reproduction guide and a one-paragraph benchmark explainer for non-technical readers.

omar: Uploading initial hero GIF + code examples to PR now. Ping me for copy edits.

lea: Thanks all. Aim to freeze assets by next Wednesday. If anything slips, update issue #1427. :sparkles:
